name: Auto Image Title & Alt
author: Diego de Guindos

sections.description:
This plugin automatically improves your SEO by adding Title and Alt Text tags to every new image uploaded to your media library. It cleans the file name from non-alphanumeric characters and uses it as the basis for these tags.

This repetitive manual task can now be fully automated.

New features and improvements:

  • Choose which image fields to update: Title, Alt Text, Caption (Excerpt), and Description (Content).
  • Select capitalization style for tags: Capitalized (default), lowercase, UPPERCASE, or leave text as-is.
  • Update image metadata instantly from the Media Library list or the individual image edit screen via a convenient button.
  • Lightweight plugin with no impact on site performance.
  • Simple settings page in WordPress admin for easy configuration.
  • Enhances website accessibility and provides Google with better image context.
  • Fully compatible with the latest WordPress versions.

Plugin features:

  • Automatically generate clean, SEO-friendly image titles and alt text based on file names.
  • Optionally update caption and description fields.
  • Apply capitalization formatting based on your preferences.
  • Manually trigger updates for existing images directly from the Media Library or image edit screen.
  • Saves time by automating tedious manual updates.
  • Zero impact on website speed or performance.

short_description: Automatically adds title and alt tags to new images in the media library, improving SEO and accessibility with customizable fields and capitalization.
